d: Get behind-the-scenes access to the 2026 NHL Heritage Classic, where the Montreal Canadiens took on the Winnipeg Jets for Canadian bragging rights. Hear Canadiens forwards Cole Caufield and Zach Bolduc, head coach Martin St. Louis, Jets defenseman Mario Ferraro, forward Mark Scheifele and head coach Scott Arniel mic'd up in a thrilling matchup at Princess Auto Stadium in Manitoba!
